title: The Second Reading of the Claw
summary: Carries a student of the basic claw texts into steady qi in the blades and a first control of the wrist.

title: A Treatise on Tine Binding
summary: A treatise on pinning arms and clothing with the hooked tines and holding the bind with a steady flow of qi.

title: Qi-Edged Raking for the Trained Hand
summary: Teaches the trained hand to run qi to the claw tips so each rake bites deeper than the body alone allows.

title: Counter-Raking and the Hooked Guard
summary: Joins the hooked guard to a counter rake so that every blow turned aside is answered by a cut in the same motion.

title: The Gauntlet Fighter's Middle Course
summary: A middle course for the fighter who wears a clawed gauntlet covering stance and strokes and the qi work that joins them.

title: Notes on Cutting Cloth and Leather
summary: Notes on feeding qi into the claw tips so they part cloth straps and leather armor along the lines of the seams.

title: Running Claw Work
summary: Teaches a claw fighter to rake while moving at a run and to stop the run on a hooked hold.

title: A Workbook of Grappling by the Hooked Hand
summary: A workbook of throws and holds that use the hooked claw as a grip and qi as the bite of that grip.
